meta.illustrativeNote: Illustrative data. This demonstration is not connected to Karnataka Government systems. Worker and beneficiary names are masked.
meta.stageNote: Cess assessed, collected, remitted and credited are separate stages. They are not added together. A difference between two stages is a reconciliation item, not a combined balance.
meta.jurisdictionNote: Labour inspections and Factories & Boilers inspections cover different lists. A factory inspection is not treated as an inspection of every construction site.
meta.boundaryNote: District boundaries follow the Census 2011 outline. Vijayanagara is not drawn separately on this illustrative map.
meta.matchNote: A relationship is shown only where the extract records a matching method. Similar names or the same district are marked as requiring verification.
